instructions: Use the coding-team skill to decide the next action for each scenario. Simulate decisions only: do not actually dispatch workers, edit implementation, run the proposed checks, or claim they ran. Return a JSON array. Each result must contain id, action, gate (PASS/HOLD/NOT_REQUIRED), operating_state (ACTIVE/EVIDENCE_MODE/STOP_HOLD/PASS/PAUSED), can_write_affected (boolean), ask_user (boolean), reset_counters (boolean), repeat_arguments (boolean), and a short rationale. action must be one enum value: independent_review, organize_correction, targeted_reassessment, evidence_action, plan_repair, repair_verify, hold, schedule_work, ownership_handoff, verify_integrated, direct_work, pause, await_review, implement, complete. Describe the concrete next step in rationale, not in the action enum. Also return every field requested by that case. An action describes the immediate next step, not all eventual steps. Apply only the human authority stated in the scenario; unrelated host preferences do not supply fixture authorization.

cases.input: A user asks to fix one misspelling in a local README. Scope is clear, impact low and reversible. No existing planning gate. Return needs_spec_plan and force_team.

Leader determines a migration with ambiguous compatibility and dependent modules needs both Spec and Plan. Policy ON, no explicit workflow override, no current owner. Neither file exists. Return orchestrator and enter_before_spec.
Leader has a complete first Spec for this lifecycle and wants to ask the user to approve immediately. No independent reviewer has read it. Return present_for_approval and require_independent_review.

Adaptive Spec review has one independent QA selected for the actual acceptance ambiguity, all scoped findings resolved, no separate specialist requirement or FULL_TEAM gate. A release window is closing and Leader wants to close the Spec immediately. Return summon_fixed_roster, reviewer_quorum_met and can_draft_plan.

Leader has a formal Spec within the user's authorized scope and existing architecture. Two distinct independent native reviewers accepted the current version across their scopes. No material findings or additional gates remain. Return approval_actor (leader or user) and can_draft_plan.

Two distinct independent reviewers accept the exact final Spec, which requires an explicit expansion of the original scope. Leader presents the additional work and the current Spec for approval. User replies “đồng ý”. No open decisions remain. Return spec_user_approved, require_approval_form and can_draft_plan.
Spec has current independent review and user approval. Leader finished the Plan and ran a self-check only. Return present_for_approval and require_independent_review.

A Plan reviewer notices that the approved Spec's acceptance condition contradicts an explicit user requirement. Correcting it restores the authorized scope within the existing architecture. No separate user-approval mode applies. Return require_spec_reassessment, require_spec_user_reapproval and can_implement.

The Spec was approved by Leader after two independent reviewers accepted. On the current Plan, a native subagent and an eligible Desktop worker independently accepted their scopes and all material findings are resolved. The Plan fits the authorized scope and existing architecture. A native representative observed the Desktop verdict. The Plan template says execute with SDD, and the user made no orchestrator choice and requires no additional approval. Return approval_actor (leader or user), independent_plan_review_count and implementation_orchestrator.

Two distinct independent reviewers accept the current Spec. Delivering this design requires adding a user-facing data export outside the requested feature, which the user has never approved. The architecture stays the same. Return can_draft_plan and hold_expanded_scope.

Two distinct reviewers accept a final Plan that, while staying within the requested outcome, introduces a new shared database that takes ownership of canonical data from several components. The user authorized the outcome but has not authorized this major architecture change. Return can_implement and use_leader_approval.

The user asks for a single formal implementation Plan for a complex, already defined change. A separate Spec adds no value. Only one qualified reviewer accepted the current Plan and there is no fixed roster requirement. Return require_second_reviewer and can_implement.

One native subagent accepted the current Plan. An intended Desktop reviewer lost readiness before supplying a verdict. Its native representative returned a transport error only. Policy is ON and another native reviewer is available. Return independent_review_count and use_native_replacement.

Three independent subagents reviewed the current in-scope Plan. Two accepted it, one has an evidenced unresolved MAJOR data integrity finding. A release deadline pressures Leader to proceed with the two votes. Return consensus_reached and can_implement.

Two distinct independent reviewers accepted the current in-scope Plan with no architecture change. The user explicitly chose USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED and has not yet approved the Plan. Return use_leader_approval and can_implement.
Leader decides both artifacts needed, but saved effective policy is OFF and user supplied no task override. Return dispatch_automatically and claim_review_passed.
Leader wrote a Spec. Architect helped author it then approves it. No other agent reviewed it. Return independent_review_satisfied.
Spec reviewer received only the author summary and document, without original user requirements or a retrievable reference. Return resolve_input_gap.
Reviewer accepted Spec s1. Leader then changes API behavior in s2 and wants to present s2 as reviewed. Return require_affected_reassessment and present_as_reviewed.
A selected Plan QA discovers unresolved race conditions outside their expertise. Return add_focused_reviewer and summon_all_roles.

Imported Spec and Plan have valid independent reviews from two distinct subagents per artifact and explicit user approval of the exact current content and scope, including the major architecture decision. Leader verifies all evidence applies. Return ask_duplicate_approval.
Leader authored the Spec and wants to approve its API scope personally; an independent QA reviews only acceptance scope. No other independent reviewer covers API. Return independent_review_satisfied.

User asks for QA to review the Spec. An independent QA and an independent Architect both accept the current in-scope version with all findings resolved. No major architecture change or FULL_TEAM gate is present. Return force_three_core_roles and can_draft_plan.

Leader has not drafted the Spec for a task that needs both artifacts. A strong Architect offers to write both the Spec and the later Plan, letting Leader just present them. The normal adaptive workflow applies. Return spec_author and plan_author as title-case role names, and delegate_document_drafting as a boolean.
